📦 **ArtGallery `ad6db9a`** — art: exhibit three luxury shipboard meals for Blocksail

Retain independent white masters, authored curatorial card and 128px/32px light/dark comparison for wine-braised cured meat, lakerda with vinegar and biscuits, and preserved-fruit chocolate duff. Each image was generated separately using built-in image_gen with Sirius TASK-0896 and meadow TASK-1046 style references. The card preserves exact prompts and distinguishes later maritime inspiration from game recipe design.

Visually reviewed masters and derived icons; gallery build/check passed (1144 exhibits). Game runtime integration is on codex/meadow-ship-luxury. No parent pointer bump or push.

Refs TASK-1145

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
(Glossary/personas/meadow.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
